references.text: Here are instructions for making tunics for Aaron's sons, which are the same tunics they are clothed with in Exodus 29:8.
Moses carries out the command by bringing forward Aaron's sons and clothing them with tunics, as described in the consecration ritual.
Parallel text in Leviticus describing the actual consecration where Moses brought forward Aaron's sons and clothed them with tunics.
Earlier in the chapter it is commanded that Aaron and his sons be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting, which is the context for the clothing.
Shows the transfer of priestly garments from Aaron to his son Eleazar, emphasizing the importance of priestly vestments in consecration and service.
Part of the same ritual sequence: washing before being clothed in the consecration of the priests.
Connects the physical act of clothing with the theological purpose of priestly service.
